content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important features and classifying outcomes when dealing with longitudinal (time-series) data, such as that collected from wearable devices, by combining logistic regression with functional data analysis techniques. The authors develop an efficient algorithm using functional principal components and an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian approach, demonstrating its effectiveness through simulations and an application examining relationships between chronic diseases and health/socio-demographic factors.
